rows.topic: Control system components and case studies
rows.textLatex:
For an angular position control servomechanism, given the following:
Moment of inertia of motor, $J_m=1.40\times10^{-6}$ kg-m²
Moment of inertia of load, $J_L=2.70\times10^{-3}$ kg-m²
Inertia of the gears is negligible.
Gear ratio, $N_1:N_2=1:100$
The detection is effected by error detectors which produce an error voltage of one volt for every degree change in input.
The motor produces a torque proportional to the applied voltage at its terminals and equals $4\times10^{-2}$ N-m when the voltage equals 115 V.
Motor friction, $f_m=7\times10^{-5}$ N-m/(rad/sec)
Damping ratio, $\zeta=0.25$
a) Draw the block diagram of the system
b) Find the steady state gain and undamped natural frequency of oscillation, $\omega_n$
c) Find the steady state error for an input turning with a constant rate of 20 rpm
